in_hebrew.name: וויני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: derived from the Hebrew word חן (chen) meaning 'grace, kindness, favor', and the suffix -י (y) meaning 'my' or 'belonging to'. Thus, Winny in Hebrew would mean 'my joy' or 'my grace'.

in_greek.name: Winny
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Friend, beloved
in_greek.long_meaning: Winny είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Germanic elements wīn meaning friend, love or dear and ni meaning kin or family. This name is derived from the Old English word wīnna, meaning to please or to win. In the Middle Ages, it was a pet form of names beginning with Wynne, Wyn, or Wynnebald.
